title: R0 open-access source audit for the current C11 / exact-channel / P7-free 4-coloring frontier

requested_topics: exact-channel decomposition and close structural analogues
methodology: author publication pages for current publication state
targeted searches for errata/corrections and public implementation artifacts
scope.caveat: No literature search proves nonexistence of an unknown or unindexed result. 'Not located' means not located in this R0 pass.

executive_findings.source_authority: Shenwei Huang, Improved complexity results on k-coloring Pt-free graphs, European Journal of Combinatorics 51 (2016), Theorem 6 in the journal presentation.
executive_findings.impact: The conditional complexity bridge is already external/source-backed: a correct polynomial-time algorithm for P7-free 4-COLORING would imply P=NP under standard polynomial-time reductions. R7 should therefore be treated as a pre-imported conditional bridge, not as an unknown theorem to discover after R6.
executive_findings.scientific_firewall: This does NOT promote P=NP now; R6 is not proved.

executive_findings.finding: Paper II Lemma 11 is explicitly a theorem for seeded precolorings of P6-free graphs.
executive_findings.source_authority: Chudnovsky–Spirkl–Zhong, Four-coloring P6-free graphs II, Lemma 11.
executive_findings.exact_hypothesis: P=(G,S,X0,X,Y0,Y,f) is a seeded precoloring of a P6-free graph satisfying axioms (i)-(v).
executive_findings.reason: The acceptability proof explicitly constructs z-y-s-p-m-n as an induced P6 and declares this a contradiction. That final contradiction is valid for P6-free graphs but not for merely P7-free graphs.
executive_findings.impact: LEMMA11_P7_LIFT remains genuinely OPEN. Existing source authority does not close it.

executive_findings.finding: List 3-Coloring is polynomial-time solvable on P7-free graphs.
executive_findings.source_authority: Bonomo et al., Three-coloring and list three-coloring of graphs without induced paths on seven vertices, Combinatorica 38 (2018).
executive_findings.exact_statement: Given a P7-free graph with lists contained in {1,2,3}, a list 3-coloring can be decided and found in polynomial time.
executive_findings.reported_running_time: O(n^21(n+m)) in the open manuscript's Theorem 1.
executive_findings.impact: This remains a legitimate P7 terminal whenever propagation gives a genuine list-3 instance. It does not solve 4-list-coloring or arbitrary four-color residuals.

executive_findings.finding: Paper I solves extension only for excellent starred precolorings of P6-free graphs (bounded seed), and the full P6 pipeline relies on Paper II to construct a polynomial-size excellent collection.
executive_findings.source_authority: Chudnovsky–Spirkl–Zhong, Four-coloring P6-free graphs I, Theorems 7/8/16 in the open manuscript.
executive_findings.impact: The excellent-to-terminal machinery is source-backed in P6-free graphs, but it does not independently bypass the P7 C11/Lemma-11 gap.

executive_findings.finding: P7-free minimal separators have a constant-size neighborhood cover.
executive_findings.source_authority: Grzesik–Klimošová–Pilipczuk–Pilipczuk, Covering minimal separators and potential maximal cliques in Pt-free graphs, EJC 28(1) (2021), Theorem 3.
executive_findings.exact_statement: For every minimal separator S in a P7-free graph G there exists S' of size at most 22 with S subseteq N_G[S'].
executive_findings.impact: Potentially useful for future R3 structural analysis, but it does NOT imply that the separator itself has size <=22 and does not close any current separator/composition gate.

executive_findings.finding: P7-free potential maximal cliques also admit bounded neighborhood-cover structure.
executive_findings.exact_statement: Every PMC Omega of a P7-free graph is contained in N[Omega'] for some vertex set Omega' of size at most 68.
executive_findings.impact: Possible structural tool for future decomposition work; not a direct coloring theorem and not a substitute for exact PI discovery.

executive_findings.finding: A recent open manuscript extends polynomial tractability of bounded-treewidth/CMSO2 sparse induced-subgraph problems to P7-free graphs of bounded clique number.
executive_findings.source_authority: Chudnovsky–Czyżewska–Kluk–Pilipczuk–Rzążewski, Sparse induced subgraphs in P7-free graphs of bounded clique number, ISAAC 2025 conference version / current open manuscript.
executive_findings.exact_statement: For fixed d, fixed clique bound k, and fixed CMSO2 formula psi, (tw<=d,psi)-MWIS is polynomial-time solvable on P7-free graphs of clique number at most k.
executive_findings.impact: This does not solve P7-free 4-COLORING because the whole input graph is not assumed to have bounded treewidth. It may strengthen future bounded-treewidth terminal or structural subroutines.

executive_findings.finding: No source located in this pass under the names exact-channel decomposition, C11 PI quotient, or P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT that directly subsumes the project's custom exact-channel normal form.
executive_findings.impact: Current exact-channel theorems should continue to be treated as internally proved graph theorems built from classical primitives (reachability, bipartite matching/Konig, Menger/connectivity), not as imported literature claims.
executive_findings.caveat: Terminology may differ in the literature; this is not a novelty claim.

executive_findings.finding: Targeted searches did not locate a public reference implementation / benchmark corpus specifically implementing the 2024 P6-free four-coloring papers or their seeded-precoloring Lemma 11 pipeline.
executive_findings.impact: Independent implementation/replay remains an internal engineering task unless a public implementation is found in a later source pass.
executive_findings.caveat: Not located is not evidence of nonexistence.

executive_findings.finding: No explicit erratum/correction for the 2024 SIAM Paper I/II pair was located in the targeted errata/correction searches in this pass.
executive_findings.impact: Use the 2024 journal/open-manuscript statements as current source authority, while retaining normal source-verification discipline.
executive_findings.caveat: Not located is not proof that no correction exists.
